title: Willow
tagline: A Decentralized Blogging platform, where creators can publish blog posts as mintable NFTs.
description:
A Decentralized Blogging platform. A web3 alternative to Medium or substack.
   Individual blog posts by creators are minted as NFTs and can be viewed on Opensea.
Collection of multiple mints from different wallet addresses make up the news feed.
  Once users are authenticated, they can view blog posts(mint) created by other users(wallet addresses) and can also make their own blog posts on the platform.
how_its_made:
The project uses web3uikit and Moralis to authenticate users and interact with the NFT minting smart contracts on the Polygon Mumbai testnets.
   Blog posts are stored on IPFS and the frontend is built using React Js.
  Hosted on IPFS, used Spheron Application hosting for the user-facing app demo.
